mustFix.problem: One placeholder dial image is used in five slots while alt text describes a spark plug, tread gauge, brake fluid reservoir and tire pressure gauge that are not shown (repeat image + alt mismatch)
mustFix.fix: Swap in the approved real frames for parts-spark-plugs, tool-tread-gauge, process-brake-fluid, process-tire-pressure; if none exist, render each slot as a distinct designed panel (different readout/instrument per slot) and set alt to describe what is actually shown, or alt="" if decorative

elevate.move: Make each report frame a different reading of the car: tread close-up with a 4/32 overlay, plug gap with a gauge strip, fluid strip with a moisture scale, each under one grade and pinned with its odometer readout, so the report is a sequence (measure, read, decide) instead of four copies of one dial

Let type carry the instrument idea end to end: tabular en-dash ranges set as readouts (3,000–5,000 mi, $90–$140), one caps label style used only on readouts, and drop the mono eyebrows so the condensed headings and giant odometer numerals are the only two voices
